name: LipSyncTool
tagline: AI lip sync video generator for photos and videos.
description: LipSyncTool is an online AI lip sync video generator that makes photos and videos talk. Upload a photo or video, add your own audio, record speech, or paste a script, then generate, preview, and download a lip-synced clip. The product supports multiple models, resolution options managed by the model, and side-by-side comparison of original inputs vs results. Use cases include talking portraits, greeters, dubbed dialogue, lessons, and character avatars.
